description: A charity team's live map on livedot for Good: where the team is on the course, who has finished, and for each fundraiser a Donate (their own Support page) and a Tap on the back. Use it for "how is the Brightpath team doing", "show me the Coast Ride team map". Without an event, the one live now (else the next, else the last one). Before the start it says when; after, the results.

charity.description: The charity as the user said it: its name ("Brightpath"), its livedot address (livedot.me/brightpath) or slug.

event.description: The event's name, id or link, when the charity has several.

keep_map.description: Only the card's own refresh sets this (it keeps the map it has).

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: charity_team_map

outputSchema.description: A charity team's live map: who is out, how far, the finishers, and a Donate and a Tap on the back for each fundraiser.

charity.description: The charity: slug, name, url (its livedot page), demo (true for the demo charity).

demo.description: The demo charity: say it is a demo.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong.

event.description: The event: id, name, kind, status (live, upcoming, past), start (ISO), tz, place, url, live_url.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user.

others.description: When several events or charities could be meant: what to choose from (name, url).

out_now.description: How many of the team are out now.

people.description: The team as the map shows them (up to 25, furthest first): name (full name only for a Findable fundraiser, else first name and initial), status, km, to_finish_km, taps.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: a free account link, when the server adds one.

sponsor_line.description: The line a free answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free (never on an answer with a Donate or Support link).

taps.description: Taps on the back so far.

total.description: How many on the team map.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Charity team map
